title: Oven Roasted Chinese Lamb Zha Jiang Mian
description: A citrusy and bouncy QQ Chinese dish from Yunnan featuring lamb kidney, served in a stone bowl dolsot style, made in a Dutch oven, and is flexitarian friendly.

ingredients.name: citrus sauce
ingredients.notes: made with orange and lemon juice

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, and cornstarch.
Add the sliced lamb kidney to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in the Dutch oven over medium high heat.
Remove the lamb from the marinade and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped scallions and cook for an additional minute.
Add the citrus sauce to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the noodles to the pot and toss to coat with the sauce and lamb mixture.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 20 minutes.
